generic_name: human papillomavirus bivalent (types 16 and 18) vaccine, recombinant, AS04-adjuvanted
geography: Worldwide (Total column of GSK's turnover tables)
indication_area: Prevention of cervical cancer / HPV 16 and 18 infection
moa: Recombinant HPV-16/18 L1 virus-like particle vaccine with AS04 adjuvant (active immunisation)

approval_evidence.quote: Following approval by the EMEA in September, GSK has recently launched Cervarix , its vaccine to prevent cervical cancer, in 12 European markets, including the UK, Germany and Belgium.

approval_note: GSK's announcements state the first launch in Australia in July 2007 and EU approval in September 2007; US (FDA/CBER) approval followed in 2009 and was not fetched.

launch_evidence.quote: Cervarix – in July GSK launched Cervarix , for prevention of cervical cancer, in Australia for use in females aged 10 to 45 years.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2007Q4, one quarter after the July 2007 launch in Australia. The Q4 2007 announcement (filed 2008-02-07) is the first with a Cervarix row (three months 9; year 2007 10); the Q3 2007 amount (about 1) is not printed as a quarter.
series_end_reason: The Q4 2025 announcement (Form 6-K filed 2026-02-04) is the last with a Cervarix row; the Q1 2026 announcement (Form 6-K filed 2026-04-29, a2755c.htm) has no Cervarix turnover row and reports the smaller vaccines in 'Other Paediatric & Adult Vaccines' (713 for the quarter).
search_log: Listed GSK plc (CIK 1131399) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (6,852 filings, 6,139 Form 6-K). Located quarterly results announcements with EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 1131399 for each of 'Boostrix', 'Rotarix', 'Cervarix', 'Synflorix' and 'Fluarix' (2001-2026); every Form 6-K HTML hit was fetched (118 documents) and every table parsed (bs4).

Quarter figure = Total (first) column of the product row in the turnover-by-product table whose nearest preceding heading reads 'Three months ended <date>' (2005-2016 'Pharmaceutical(s and Vaccines) turnover', from 2017 'Vaccines turnover – three months ended <date>'); six-month, nine-month and year tables are excluded by their heading. Where a period is printed in more than one filing, the earliest-filed announcement (the one reporting it as current) is used; the 2010-09-10 Form 6-K restating 2008-2010 quarters is not cited.
Cervarix 2019Q4 and 2025Q3 are printed as negative quarters ((13) and (11)), kept as printed.
